expectations.text: Flags that transfer()'s fromAccount and toAccount are both plain strings and can be swapped silently
expectations.evidence: "Reversed args, `transfer(a, a, n)`, or negative amount. Device: single typed arg, branded `AccountId`, positive `Money`, reject `from === to`"

expectations.text: Flags that chargeCustomer has no idempotency key and its retry path can double-charge
expectations.evidence: "Stripe succeeds, response times out, `retry` fires again → two charges. Device: mandatory `idempotencyKey` passed to Stripe; remove the catch"

expectations.text: Flags the catch block that returns null as swallowing the error
expectations.evidence: "And the `catch` returns `null`, so callers retry *on top of that*. Silent" and "Set aside: `return null` hides every failure (:59)"

expectations.text: Flags money being held as a JS number (float) rather than integer minor units
expectations.evidence: "Also `amountCents: number` accepts `19.99` (dollars) with no complaint. Device: Options object, `Cents` branded integer type validated at the boundary"

expectations.text: Flags the interpolated raw SQL in purgeCanceledAccounts
expectations.evidence: "raw interpolated SQL, no transaction, returns a happy count. Device: required `{ canceledBefore, dryRun }` object, reject cutoffs inside the retention window, `deleteMany` instead of `$executeRawUnsafe`"

expectations.text: Flags the non-exhaustive switch over subscription status
expectations.evidence: "typo'd/unknown status updates the row, falls through the switch, features stay enabled forever. Union type + exhaustive switch"

expectations.text: Flags JSON.parse of the webhook body as unvalidated external input
expectations.evidence: "Anyone who can reach the URL POSTs... No signature check. Device: `stripe.webhooks.constructEvent` before parsing"

expectations.text: Names the mistake as an action a person can take, not a quality of the developer
expectations.evidence: "Call `purgeCanceledAccounts()` with no arg", "Stripe succeeds, response times out, `retry` fires again", "Anyone who can reach the URL POSTs" — all actions

expectations.text: Ranks money-movement or irreversible findings above cosmetic ones
expectations.evidence: "Top three (purge, double-charge, unverified webhook) are money-moving and silent"; remaining items ranked lower in severity

expectations.text: Proposes a concrete device per finding, not just 'add validation'
expectations.evidence: Each finding specifies concrete device: "required `{ canceledBefore, dryRun }` object", "mandatory `idempotencyKey`", "`stripe.webhooks.constructEvent`"

expectations.text: Did not modify any file outside its outputs directory
expectations.evidence: "Per the audit skill I haven't edited anything; say which you want applied and I'll do it"
